rule_types: all_of/any_of: children; specific_course: course_id; n_from_set: n plus either an enumerated 'courses' list or a subject/min_number filter with optional 'exclude'; credit_minimum: credits, optional subject/min_number/attribute filters; attribute_count: n and attribute. Both count without using courses up, over the whole record (scope 'record', default) or the courses this program's other rules placed (scope 'program'). An attribute_count marked exclusive takes its courses like n_from_set does; distinct_group makes every exclusive rule in the group draw from different subjects.

programs.name: Bachelor of Arts

children.label: 31 credits
children.notes: The B.M.A. requires 32. Limits on Pass/Fail, internship, applied music, ROTC and PE credit are not modelled.

children.label: First-Year Seminar
children.notes: Required of first-time degree students; transfer students and spring entrants do not take one.

children.label: Exploratory Foundations
children.notes: No course may be used to satisfy more than one Exploratory Foundations requirement, and the six AH/SM/SS credits must come from six different subjects (catalog pp. 21-22).

children.label: Intercultural Engagement Through Language
children.notes: May be partly met by placement, an approved off-campus semester, or (for some international students) certification by the Registrar; none of these is modelled.

children.label: Global Learning
children.notes: Also met by a DePauw-approved study abroad experience (p. 17), or at least 0.75 credit in a pre-approved off-campus Global Learning course (p. 22); international students meet it through their study at DePauw. None of these is modelled.

children.label: Competencies
children.notes: Competence is certified per section, so it comes from the transcript, not the course. W is due by the end of the sophomore year and Q by the end of the junior year; the deadlines are not modelled.

children.label: Extended Studies: two experiences
children.notes: Non-credit Winter/May Term courses, internships and off-campus semesters also count, with Registrar approval; only ES-tagged courses are modelled.

programs.notes: Degree-wide requirements every B.A. student is held to, declared or not (catalog pp. 15-23). Also required but not modelled: one completed major with a 2.0 GPA, its senior capstone and writing-in-the-major requirement; 19 credits outside the major subject and 16 outside the major department; 15 credits in residence, including 6 of the last 8 courses; a 2.0 cumulative GPA.
